# EvidenceCheck
Evidence-first vendor due-diligence APIs for procurement, security, GRC and AI-agent workflows.

Canonical API: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com
Website: https://evidencecheck-site.onrender.com

Machine discovery:
- Agent card: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
- Pricing JSON: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/pricing.json
- x402 metadata: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/x402
- Skill guide: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/skill.md

Payment:
- Protocol: x402 v2 exact
- Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)
- Asset: USDC
- PayTo: 0x031a713863890eb611776aadd48397873ed153ab
- Facilitator: https://facilitator.openx402.ai

Services:
- POST /vendor-preflight — $0.025 — public vendor evidence preflight
- POST /site-audit — $0.01 — public website security preflight
- POST /web-extract — $0.005 — webpage text/metadata extraction
- POST /analyze — $0.005 — business-document triage

Important boundaries:
- Public evidence is not proof of internal control effectiveness.
- Unknown means unverified, not failed.
- No authenticated testing, exploitation, certification or legal opinion.
- Human review remains responsible for material procurement/security decisions.
